_meta.what: Elements shared code prints inside many blocks, by the css_element name the framework DB gives their state rows. Calibration (lib/calibrate-instances.mjs::stateTarget) looks for the block's own class sgs-<block>__<element> OR this shared selector, so a block that prints its own element still finds it first.
_meta.add_when: a state setting's rule is printed by a shared helper or the shared wrapper under a class that is not the block's own BEM name; cite the helper

overlay.source: plugins/sgs-blocks/includes/media/background-css.php::sgs_bg_overlay_css: the shared background renderer prints the overlay span .sgs-bg-overlay and scopes backgroundOverlayColourHover / backgroundOverlayGradientHover on `.{uid} > .sgs-bg-overlay`; every block holding the overlay settings also declares it as supports.sgs.elements.overlay, which stateTarget takes first
